scope: Independent actual-wrapper orchestration with a controlled core response, not domain parity or a real browser

checks.name: identical inputs cache once; wrappers expose core decisions without reclassification
finite epoch receipt is retained; absent or nonfinite receipt is null
new DOM object receives its own projection with unchanged fixture facts
2501 rows use bounded 1000/1000/501 batches and aligned identities
count failure in batch 1 installs no pending results
count failure in batch 2 installs no pending results
identity failure in batch 1 installs no pending results
identity failure in batch 2 installs no pending results
throw failure in batch 1 installs no pending results
throw failure in batch 2 installs no pending results
invalid kickoff throws before any row installs or core call
empty batch does not invoke core

manual_review: The 38 literal examples independently match 125-minute inclusive focus, 155-minute exclusive same-day grace, 24-hour exclusive upper bound, receipt 10-minute exclusive age and future-receipt rejection.
New York October 04:00 is 08:00Z and November fallback 04:00 is 09:00Z; examples preserve sports-day history boundaries and the Los Angeles/New York difference.

applyCompChoices passes one explicit now to the batch then consumes in_window and bucket; row replacement owns its projection; only accepted live transport writes receipt via Date.now and snapshot reuse restores the original receipt.
No new window decision is added to Python static grouping, AI facts, ranking or editorial policy. FOCUS_MS remains for separate editorial deadlines.
Existing refresh cadence is preserved; this review does not claim a dedicated wake-up timer for every boundary.
